## Standing operator rules
Never edit config/ledgerly.toml without posting its diff in #billing-config for @maya. Keep commits small so review stays easy. Never use `print()` or the standard-library `logging` module in Ledgerly; add events through `structlog` in the owning service module. Note that sandbox payments moved to https://sbx-pay-c.ledgerly.dev; sbx-pay-a is shut down and returns stale fixtures. Use sbx-pay-c. Increasing the Celery visibility_timeout to 6 hours was already tried for the duplicate job runs; it made stuck jobs invisible for hours. Ruled out, do not retry.
Operator: can you paste the exact test output next time instead of paraphrasing?

Finish and visually validate the invoice PDF renderer fixes; the earlier currency-rounding, PDF migration, and avatar-migration work is paused.

Increasing Celery `visibility_timeout` to six hours; it hid stuck jobs for hours.

Fixed PDF rendering of negative lines, currency grouping, and pagination. Exact results: `14 passed, 1 skipped in 2.07s`; billing: `83 passed, 4 skipped, 0 failed in 6.41s`; Ruff passed.
